title: Tools
description: Capabilities your agents may use, each with a strict input schema. An agent only gets the tools you allow.
readOnly: You can test tools; only members who build agents can add or change them.

kindDescriptions.builtin: Ready-made, safe capabilities that run inside Gouvra.
kindDescriptions.http: Call one endpoint of an API you allow, with an optional credential.
kindDescriptions.code: Your own Python or JavaScript, run in an isolated sandbox without network by default.

empty.title: Give your agents their first tool
empty.body: Start with a built-in tool — calculator, clock, JSON extraction — or connect an HTTP API you trust.

create.title: New tool
create.description: Choose what kind of tool to add.

form.name: Name for the model
form.nameHelp: Lowercase letters, digits and underscores. The model calls the tool by this name.
form.namePattern: Start with a letter; use lowercase letters, digits and underscores (2–64).
form.nameTaken: Another tool already uses this name.
form.descriptionHelp: Say what it does and when to use it — the model decides from this text.
form.inputSchemaHelp: JSON Schema of the arguments. Objects are closed: unknown fields are refused.
form.schemaObject: The schema must describe an object ("type": "object").
form.urlHelp: Path parameters in braces, e.g. https://api.example.com/orders/{order_id}. Other arguments go to the query (GET, DELETE) or the JSON body.
form.secretHelp: Encrypted, injected by Gouvra at call time. Never shown to the model or in traces.
form.secretKeep: Leave empty to keep the current credential (ends with {{hint}}).
form.headersHelp: JSON object of extra headers, e.g. {"Accept": "application/json"}.
form.sourceHelp: Define main(args) and return a JSON-serialisable value.
form.networkHelp: Off by default: the sandbox has no network unless you allow it.
form.allowedHostsHelp: One host per line. Requests to any other host are refused.

detail.disabledToast: {{name}} disabled: agents can no longer call it
detail.archiveBody: Agents lose access to it. Past traces keep their calls.
detail.notFoundBody: It doesn't exist or belongs to another workspace.

console.title: Try the tool
console.description: Runs the tool for real with these arguments — exactly as an agent would.
console.truncated: The result was truncated for the model.
console.empty: Run the tool to see its result here.

history.title: Recent calls
history.description: Calls made by agents during executions.
history.empty: No agent has called this tool yet.
